title: Annotatio III §.X: Else it turns the Church Antichristian — tyrannizing Revelation, Reason, and the Senses
pass_a_gloss: Otherwise about to transform this Church (establishing especially the Necessity of itself by many Anathemas) into a truly Antichristian one, tyrannically insulting both divine Revelation concerning things to be believed and done alike, and human Reason, nay all the Senses, and trying to break and abolish their force.
pass_b_english: Otherwise it remakes the Church truly Antichristian — especially by staking its own Necessity on many Anathemas.
It tyrannizes divine Revelation (belief and practice), human Reason, and all the Senses, trying to break and abolish their force.
source_text: Transformatura alioquin hanc, (maximè omnium Necessitatem sui pluribus Anathematibus stabiliens) in verè Antichristianam, tam Revelationi divinæ de credendis pariter atque faciendis, quam Rationi humanæ, quin Sensibus omnibus, tyrannice insultans eorumque Vim infringere, atque abolere conata.
